items.question: What is Lasuarindo Group?
items.answer: Lasuarindo Group is an integrated business and investment company managing six business lines: investment, property, technology, media, F&B, and lifestyle.

items.question: What are the Group's business lines?
items.answer: There are six business lines: investment, property and district ecosystem, technology, media and creative, F&B and consumer, and lifestyle and entertainment.

items.question: Where can I see more detail on each business line?
items.answer: A summary of each business line is available on Our Businesses. Further detail will be added once the data is available.

items.question: What is the T46 district?
items.answer: T46 is a Lasuarindo Group business district in Bandung, where twelve units operate within one ecosystem.

items.question: How many business units operate in T46?
items.answer: Twelve business units operate there, grouped into three categories: directly managed, partnerships, and district ecosystem.

items.question: Does each unit have a detail page?
items.answer: Each unit has a detail page with an overview and capabilities. We are still refining the details; please check the Units page for the latest information.

items.question: Does Lasuarindo Group welcome partnerships?
items.answer: Yes. We are open to strategic collaborations with investors, entrepreneurs, and institutions. Please share your proposal through our Partnership or Contact page.

items.question: Where should I send an investment or collaboration inquiry?
items.answer: You can read more on the Investor or Collaboration page, then send your inquiry through the Contact page.

items.question: How does the collaboration process work?
items.answer: We are preparing a clearer explanation of the process. In the meantime, please send your plans through the Contact page.

items.question: Is basic business licensing information available?
items.answer: Basic licensing information for PT Lasuarindo Group, including its Business Identification Number (NIB), is available on the Licensing page.

items.question: Where can I find the privacy policy and terms and conditions?
items.answer: Both documents are available on the Legal Information page, via the Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions links.

items.question: How do I contact Lasuarindo Group?
items.answer: You can email our official address or use the form on the Contact page.

items.answer: Yes. The contact form can be used for general questions, information requests, and collaboration proposals.
